title: RoboMME-Interference: Benchmarking Robot Memory Under Interference
abstract: arXiv:2606.22338v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robots deployed in realistic settings will accumulate experience across many sessions and tasks over their deployment. The robot's tasks may often require it to remember information from multiple sessions ago, making long-context robot memory important for real-world deployments. However, most robot-memory benchmarks today are based on single episodes or a short context. To measure how current robot memory systems perform on longer sessions with more distractions, we introduce RoboMME-Interference, a cross-session benchmark built on RoboMME (Dai et al., 2026). For each query episode, we construct a session history using the query's relevant prior demonstration followed by a controlled number of unrelated sessions, which we provide to the VLA as memory and measure accuracy. translated_title: RoboMME-Interference：干扰下的机器人记忆基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.22338v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：部署在现实环境中的机器人会在其部署期间跨多个会话和任务积累经验。机器人的任务往往需要它记住多个会话之前的信息，这使得长上下文机器人记忆对于实际部署至关重要。然而，目前大多数机器人记忆基准测试基于单次情节或短上下文。为了衡量当前机器人记忆系统在更长会话和更多干扰下的表现，我们引入了RoboMME-Interference，这是一个基于RoboMME（Dai等人，2026）构建的跨会话基准测试。对于每个查询情节，我们使用查询相关的先前演示构建一个会话历史，随后加入受控数量的无关会话，并将其作为记忆提供给视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），然后测量准确性。通过在该基准测试上运行RoboMME发布的未经修改的记忆增强π0.5变体，我们发现感知记忆变体虽然有所改进，但成功……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出了RoboMME-Interference，一个跨会话机器人记忆基准，用于评估长上下文和干扰下VLA模型的记忆性能，并发现现有感知记忆变体在干扰下表现有限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RoboMME-Interference, a cross-session robot memory benchmark to evaluate VLA models under long contexts and interference, revealing limitations of current perceptual memory variants.
